title: Henderson the Rain King

vibeProfile.oneLine: A restless American flees to Africa and stumbles into kingship and wisdom.

summary: Eugene Henderson, a rich, restless American giant tormented by an inner voice crying I want, I want, flees his tangled life for a journey into a mythic Africa, where he blunders into kingship, rainmaking and a rough sort of wisdom. Bellow's exuberant, comic novel is a philosophical quest dressed as an adventure, ranging over desire, death and the hunger for meaning in a big, generous, roaring voice. Odd, funny and profound, it is many readers' favourite Bellow.
whyReadIt: Bellow's roaring, comic quest for meaning, dressed as an African adventure. Big-hearted, funny and profound.

funFacts.text: Bellow had never been to Africa when he wrote it; the setting is deliberately mythic.
